about_the_game:
Hiring Now: Baristas!

Become Barista is a coffee shop management sim combined with life simulation. You'll start your barista journey in the city with a cozy apartment and a charming corner café.

features

  • Brew classic coffee drinks, from rich espresso to creamy lattes, satisfying even the most demanding customers.

  • Unleash your creativity by crafting signature specialty drinks, turning your café into the city’s most popular hotspot.

  • Listen to customers’ stories, fulfill their unique coffee cravings, and maybe even uncover unexpected surprises.

  • Manage your ingredients wisely—keep your coffee beans and supplies fresh to serve the finest flavors every day.

  • Unlock a delivery system, master the art of coffee-making, and spread the aroma of your brews across the city to boost profits.

  • Expand your business by opening a bakery, where you can bake delicious pastries that pair perfectly with coffee, attracting even more customers.

  • Design your personal space—decorate your apartment with furniture and décor, creating a cozy retreat for your quiet moments.

"We're low on milk, don't forget to order some today."

"No decent bakery in this part of town, huh?" a customer muttered, the craving for a good croissant evident. And in that simple lament, you caught a scent – the scent of opportunity.
